question: To whom is the Orange Cap awarded in the Indian Premier League (IPL)?

options.text: Highest run scorer in the league
Highest wicket taker in the league

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Highest run scorer in the league**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Orange Cap** is awarded to the **highest run scorer** in a single season of the **Indian Premier League (IPL).**
 
• Introduced in the **inaugural season of IPL in 2008**, the Orange Cap symbolizes the batting excellence of a player throughout the league.
 
• The player who has scored the most runs wears the Orange Cap on the field during matches, and the final holder of the cap is announced at the end of the season.
 
• If two or more players score the same number of runs, the award is given to the player with the **higher strike rate.**
 
• Some notable players who have won the Orange Cap include **Chris Gayle, David Warner, Virat Kohli, and KL Rahul.**
 
• The Orange Cap is an incentive for players to perform consistently and contribute significantly to their team’s performance.
 
• This recognition enhances the profile of the winning player and demonstrates their role as a key contributor to the league.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Youngest player of the league**__

 __
 
• While the IPL does not have a specific award for the **youngest player**, it often highlights young talent through its **Emerging Player Award.**
 
• The youngest players in IPL history, such as **Prayas Ray Barman** and **Noor Ahmad**, have gained significant attention for their skills and potential.
 
 
 
• **Emerging player of the league**__
 __
 
• This award is given to a young player who has shown exceptional talent and promise during the tournament.
 
• Criteria for this award include being under the age of **25**, having played fewer than **five Test matches**, and not having been part of more than **two IPL seasons.**
 
 
 
• **Highest wicket taker in the league**__
 
 
• The **highest wicket taker** in the IPL is awarded the **Purple Cap**, which is equivalent to the Orange Cap for bowlers.
 
• Players like **Lasith Malinga, Dwayne Bravo, and Bhuvneshwar Kumar** have held the Purple Cap in previous seasons.
